summary.text: Cullin Knutson is the Democratic candidate for Texas House of Representatives District 86 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A political consultant, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that his priorities include health care access, public schools and support for rural Texas communities.

paragraphs.text: Cullin Knutson earned a high school diploma from Amarillo High School and a bachelor's degree from Texas State University in 2014.
His career experience includes working as a political consultant.
Knutson advanced from the Democratic primary on March 3, 2026.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Knutson said he supports expanding Medicare and Medicaid, ending the school voucher program, and raising teacher pay and benefits.
He also said the state should direct more funding to small rural cities for needs such as water and wastewater generators, early warning systems and firefighters.
